limitations: Saturation is proven only inside the declared charter: primitive span at most three, arity at most two, and generation at most three.
The system autonomously chooses experiments within that charter; the eight primitives, MDL reward, and safety boundaries remain externally supplied.
The generated worlds are program-behavior experiments, not unrestricted physical or mathematical universes.
A safety maximum of 32 rounds exists, but successful runs must stop earlier through four consecutive sterile rounds.

capability_change.before: V16 required an external script to supply each anonymous workload corpus
capability_change.after: the loop diagnoses its current semantic gap, selects an experiment, generates worlds, learns, verifies, and stops at measured saturation

claim.achieved: autonomous experiment selection and semantic saturation inside a finite declared research charter
claim.not_claimed: saturation of mathematics as a whole or removal of all externally supplied safety boundaries
